race.comment: LAYLA (12) sets the standard after resuming with a solid second in a BM66 at Cranbourne, beaten just over a length by the handy Marsept after being near the top of betting. She comes back to BM62 company, has placed in three of four starts and can notch up another win here. JACKPOT PARK (1) is the obvious danger, unbeaten in two runs this campaign and already a winner at this track and distance after putting away Whiskey Joe in Class 1 grade last start. Big weight now but can win again. BRAZENGA (10) also comes through BM66 form, fighting on for third at Warrnambool when beaten a length and a half, and his track-and-trip record reads well. EMPRESSIVE ENUFF (4) is going okay, Lane sticks from a good gate and he'll run well.
